products.name: SambaNova
products.note: Enterprise AI hardware+software; DataScale platform; on-prem deployment; sovereign AI

profile_text.body:
SambaNova Systems is an AI infrastructure company that describes itself as offering a complete platform for AI inference, fine-tuning, and agentic AI workloads, designed to integrate into existing data center environments. The company positions its technology around a dataflow architecture and memory design it says delivers the performance needed for large AI models, and it offers on-premises deployment as a core feature. JPMorganChase is cited on the company's site as a customer that has selected SambaNova's RDUs for on-premises AI inference.

The company's product lineup includes the DataScale platform, SambaStack, which switches between multiple frontier-scale models to support agentic AI workflows on a single node, and SambaOrchestrator, a tool for managing and scaling AI workloads across data centers. SambaNova also describes a sovereign AI platform aimed at keeping data governed within national borders, supported by a network of sovereign AI data center partners. The company characterizes its broader offering as a composable, end-to-end stack spanning agents, models, knowledge, and data.

On the funding side, the company's site reports a valuation of $11 billion, with General Atlantic leading a funding round that also drew investment from Seligman Ventures and T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc. No litigation or regulatory filings appear in the held facts for SambaNova Systems.
